measured_checks.margin_note: measured on the text layer's ink (full render minus the text-free art render, 300 dpi). Line boxes are nudged by -2.88 pt (top) and +1.44 to +3.84 pt (bottom) so cap tops and last baselines/descenders sit on the 36 pt margin optically. Art is full-bleed and exempt.

bleed.print_file: menu-print-bleed.pdf (9.25 x 11.75 in: trim + 9 pt bleed + 18 pt slug with crop marks)

measured_checks.item_gap_note: 7 pt unit: line boxes 14 pt (names, italic lines, ingredients, serve lines, H3, allergen) or 21 pt (H2); 7 pt between single rows and within subs; 14 pt between cocktail blocks; 7 pt + 14 pt H3 line across a sub; 35 pt + 28 pt H2 block + 7 pt across a section
measured_checks.dead_space: reading area 282-576 pt filled edge to edge: cocktails full width; Beer & Cider and Wine | Spirits on one two-column grid (282-420 | 438-576); right ink margin 36.7 pt (matches the other sides). Quiet pockets: under the cider (single item) and under Spirits (3 name-only rows); the allergen line sits on the bottom margin
measured_checks.contrast_method: text-free render at 300 dpi; each text line box narrowed to its ink box (+2 px); every background pixel compared with the text colour; the minimum ratio is reported
